title: Asia-Pacific markets rally as Huang’s return to Nvidia reignites AI trade, despite US political backlash – business live
summary: Republicans and Democrats object over Trump’s role in Jensen Huang’s return as Nvidia CEO, following an affair with an alleged Chinese spy

blocks.text:
Republicans and Democrats object over Trump’s role in Jensen Huang’s return as Nvidia CEO, following an affair with an alleged Chinese spy

  • Republican senators criticize Nvidia’s decision to reinstate Jensen Huang


Chinese state media have warned that Jensen Huang’s reinstatement won’t end tensions between Beijing and Washington, or restrictions on AI chip exports.

China’s Global Times newspaper published a commentary urging China to “remain vigilant” today, saying:

“It is foreseeable that the malicious attempts to sow discord in China-US relations will not automatically disappear simply because Huang has been reinstated.”

There’s the massive spending needed to build AI infrastructure, the pressure on free cash flow at hyperscalers — Nvidia’s biggest clients — and the need for these companies to raise money through equity or bond issuance.

Then there are rising borrowing costs as inflation stays elevated and credit spreads widen, and of course the political hurdles with Democrats set to take control of Congress.
